{"body":"Hi Glejn,

I checked the cluster: the castai-agent pod itself is running, so the 401 Authorization Required entries are coming from a component that still holds the previous secret value from before the rotation. We reproduced the same signature in a sandbox by leaving one component secret stale while the others were updated.

Per the documentation from our token rotation test runs, which secrets need updating depends on the install topology. With the standard castctl cluster connect install there is one shared secret, castai-credentials in the castai-agent namespace, so updating that single secret is enough. Helm and Terraform installs use per-component secrets (castai-agent, castai-cluster-controller, castai-spot-handler, castai-evictor, castai-workload-autoscaler), so every component secret must be updated. Afterwards, restart every component so it picks up the new value.

The old cluster token stays valid for at least 60 minutes after rotation — we measured this empirically and there is no revoke endpoint — which is why the 401s continue until each component has been restarted with the updated secret.

— CAST AI Support"}
